lines.lyric: I wanna big house, big cars & big rings

lines.lyric_translation: But actually, I don’t have any big dreams
Haha, I live quite comfortably

lines.lyric: Ggum ddawi an ggwodo amudo mwora an hajanheo
lines.lyric_hangul: 꿈 따위 안 꿔도 아무도 뭐라 안 하잖아
lines.lyric_translation: Even if I don’t dream, no one says anything

lines.lyric_hangul: 전부 다-다-다 똑가같이 나처럼 생각하고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: Everyone is thinking / the same way as me

lines.lyric_hangul: 새까-까-까맣게 까먹은 꿈 많던 어린 시절
lines.lyric_translation: I completely forgot about my childhood / when I had a lot of dreams

lines.lyric_hangul: 대학은 걱정 마, 멀리 라도 갈 거니까
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t worry about college, / I’ll at least go to a school that’s far away
Ok mom, I’m going to the library right now
What is the you that you’ve dreamed of?

lines.lyric: Jigeum ni geoul sogen nuga boyeo, I gotta say
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 네 거울 속엔 누가 보여?
lines.lyric_translation: Who do you see in the mirror? I gotta say

lines.lyric_hangul: I gotta say, 너의 길을 가라고 단 하루를 살아도
lines.lyric_translation: Go on your path / Even if you live for a day
Do something / Put away your weakness

lines.lyric_hangul: 왜 말 못하고 있어? 공부는 하기 싫다면서
lines.lyric_translation: Why aren’t you saying anything? / You don’t wanna study

lines.lyric_hangul: 학교 때려 치기는 겁나지? 이거 봐, 등교할 준비하네 벌써
lines.lyric_translation: but you’re scared to quit school? / See, you’re already getting ready for school

lines.lyric_hangul: 철 좀 들어 제발 좀, 너 입만 살아가지고, 인마, 유리 멘탈 boy
lines.lyric_translation: Please grow up, you’re all talk dude, / you have a glass mentality, boy

parts.lyric: Cheol jom deureo jebal jom, neo ibman saragajigo

lines.lyric_hangul: Stop! 자신에게 물어봐, 언제 네가 열심히 노력했냐고?

lines.lyric_translation: See me, see me, ya you’re a hypocrite

lines.lyric: Wae jakku ddan gireul garae ya neona jalhae
lines.lyric_hangul: 왜 자꾸 딴 길을 가래? 야, 너나 잘해

lines.lyric_translation: Grown-ups and my parents / keep instilling confined dreams to me / Number one future career is a government worker?
It’s not a forced dream, a ninth inning relief pitcher
Throw a fast ball at the waste of time that is night study sessions

lines.lyric_hangul: 지옥 같은 사회에 반항해 꿈을 특별사면
lines.lyric_translation: Rebel against the hellish society, / dreams are a special pardon / Ask yourself about your dream profile
